body:
> Let's do a POC at implementing lazyload: true on the hits widget, it should then only render react hits elements when they are visible, with an offset (so that if you start scrolling, you already see some).

Did we feel the pain somehow? I've the feeling that except when you have a crazy amount of big/non-appropriated pictures per  page, you never need such optimization - even if we're talking about dozens of hits - that should be super fast.
